125570.overview: M. CHEN, master of KUNG FU, hates the members of the TUE family, made of brutal and unscrupulous personas. Learning that his fiancée's father has been killed by the TUE Chief, he burns to avenge her. Thanks to his mastery of KUNG FU, help Mr. CHEN get to his enemy's castle, having triumphed over his henchmen, vase throwers, giants, steel stars and bulls all standing in his way. Then defeat the TUE Leader to win. For 1 or 2 players. Also includes a possibility of combat between 2 Players.

125574.overview: You are on the Planet NEBULA during the time of the Pharaohs in 2019. A thousand of pitfalls await you and the Gods see you when you approach their tombs. Can you use your laser beams and homing bombs to destroy them? Make no mistake, because it will be fatal! Contains four levels for one or two players.
